philippines.title: WNBA scores: Valkyries beat expansion Tempo for 6th straight win
philippines.description:
TORONTO — Janelle Salaun scored 26 points and the Golden State Valkyries held off the expansion Toronto Tempo 83-75 in the WNBA on Wednesday night for their sixth straight victory. Fellow reserve Kaitlyn Chen added 16 points for Golden State (16-7). Kayla Thornton had 15 points and nine rebounds. Isabelle Harrison had 24 points and eight rebounds for Toronto (9-12). The Tempo have lost three straight. Marina Mabrey scored 11 points a day after being named the Tempo’s first WNBA All-Star. She also had six rebounds and four assists.
